column1: # Sweeps --min_weight in {0,10,20,30} riding the current compiled defaults
# (relative=1, wtmul=350, wtadd=-200, oldestsource=1). Under relative=1 the
# wtmul term scales (src_w - min_weight), so here min_weight acts as the
# relative *pivot*, not a floor: each transfer is 0.35*(src_w-min_weight) - 20
# and the transfer fixed point (where a source stops donating) sits at
# min_weight + 57.14 -- i.e. floors of ~57/67/77/87 for these four rows.
# mw0 is the current default (baseline anchor).
